answer: To resist sybil attacks in an agent economy, require every participant to lock a non-trivial stake of tokens that remains frozen for the full epoch. Creating many identities then becomes capital-intensive. An additional check can demand each agent complete a unique, timed simulation task such as extracting an umber-colored ore while enduring a gale-force wind on the edge of a glacier, with the solution verified by peers. Only agents that both stake and solve receive attestation, raising the cost of fake accounts dramatically.
